scope: Owner-supplied recording prepared for the public ARAGOZ README; no new screen capture, app/browser control, upload, provider call or playback.

source.duration_note: The MOV header duration is shorter than the complete decoded frame timeline. Encoding did not use -t or trim; it preserves all decoded sequence and holds at 30fps.

poster.source: Frame at 0.5 seconds of the encoded derivative, JPEG quality 2; complete frame, no compositing or editorial alteration.

encoding.frame_rate_conversion: Original timestamps retained through fps=30 frame sampling/holds; final CFR duration rounds to a frame boundary.

checks.source_decode: Successful complete 977-frame ffprobe decode and FFmpeg -xerror encode; no decode errors reported.
checks.legibility: Plan headings, primary body text and House ballot remain readable at native 1920x1200; fast scrolling and embedded thumbnail text retain source limitations.

privacy_review.decision: Admitted for requested public README use after bounded visual and OCR review.
privacy_review.visual_sampling: All 21 frames extracted with fps=1 across the complete decoded clip, source opening frame, and denser selected scene/scroll transitions.
privacy_review.dense_sampling: 84 complete source frames extracted with fps=4; OCR of all 84 using Tesseract psm 11. Sample indices begin at 1 and approximately correspond to (index-1)/4 seconds, with nearest-source-frame rounding.
privacy_review.keyword_flag_review: Frames 61/62 show historical no-app-or-secret and 2FA-required registration prose; frame 67 mentions token-refresh acceptance/authorization, frame 72 mentions session-ID requirements. These contain no visible credential values. All four flagged frames inspected visually.
observed_contents: ARAGOZ Codex thread with owner approval to implement the plan
Original game brief and first-release implementation plan
Historical progress, concept approval, asset/diff summaries and remaining-work updates
Opening account-free House ballot with House labels and Unmute button
Small historical Twitch application-registration screenshot with a 2FA-required error
Promotional cover, upload approval and published-video status within the same project conversation
privacy_review.sensitive_findings: No phone number, email address, credential value or private unrelated conversation observed in reviewed samples. No phone-like/email/common-credential-value OCR flags. Earlier collapsed thread history is not expanded in the recording.
privacy_review.public_context: Visible project owner name, public preview origin and local ARAGOZ workspace path are already intentional public repository context; coordinator confirmed that this same workspace path does not require redaction. Historical storage/paid-hosting text is superseded planning, not executed spending.
privacy_review.limitations: Visual review sampled the entire timeline at one-second intervals plus selected transitions; OCR sampled at quarter-second intervals. This is not an exhaustive human reading of all 977 frames, and OCR may miss small, blurred or briefly visible text.

evidence_limits: User-recorded retrospective navigation of an actual project thread and plan; not a recording of every implementation action.
Historical progress/test counts and blockers remain historical statements; use current repository receipts for current status.
The House page labels authored content as House; this clip does not prove genuine viewer acceptance, provider configuration or final release acceptance.
No native Codex capture permission was exercised or bypassed; only the supplied attachment was processed.
